headline: Dollar General posted a strong 4.3% Q4 comp but guided 2026 comps lower to 2.2-2.7%, and shares slipped.
guidance_note: FY26: net sales +3.7-4.2%, same-store sales +2.2-2.7%, EPS $7.10-7.35 incl. ~$0.13 hit from expired Work Opportunity Tax Credit.
key_messages: Q4 same-store sales +4.3% on traffic +2.6% and ticket +1.7%; FY25 comps +3.0%, EPS $6.85.
Gross margin +105 bps to 30.4%, helped by lower shrink; further gains expected in 2026 but to a much lesser extent.
January boosted by stock-up ahead of winter storms; February storms closed some stores.
Vasos: consumer sentiment remains cautious and stagnant, and inflation remains sticky.
Guidance does not assume significant tariff-driven demand impact or share buybacks.

consumer.pricing: Management called inflation sticky; guidance excludes any significant tariff-driven demand impact.
consumer.quote: Consumer sentiment does remain cautious and stagnant, and inflation remains sticky.

macro_read: Solid traffic shows lower-income shoppers still leaning on dollar stores for essentials, but management expects 2026 growth to slow amid sticky inflation.

sources.label: Motley Fool: DG Q4 2025 call transcript
